emailSubject: A sharper site for Slim Secret's GLP-1 program (built a preview)
emailBody:
Hi Dr. Rodriguez,

I came across Slim Secret Med Spa while looking at med spas in McAllen — your Google reviews are excellent, and patients clearly love the GLP-1 program. Your current site undersells that, so I built a free preview of what a refreshed homepage could look like:

https://drusus-tech.github.io/website_demos/slim-secret-med-spa-demo/

It leads with your physician-led Tirzepatide & Semaglutide program and your dual board certification, puts real patient results (English y Español) front and center, and gives mobile visitors a one-tap Call / Book Consult bar so more phone traffic turns into consultations.

Happy to walk you through it or tailor it further — no obligation.

Best,
Drusus Technologies
hello@drusustechnologies.com
gitCommands: cd ~/Documents/GitHub/website_demos && git add slim-secret-med-spa-demo/index.html leads.json && git commit -m "Add Slim Secret Med Spa demo" && git push origin main
problems: Generic WordPress template; brand (lime/gray S mark) looks dated and low-res
Hero doesn't explain the GLP-1 offer or physician credentials above the fold
Heavy third-party review widget and many social-logo images slow the page
No persistent mobile call/booking CTA; contact form buried
Bilingual patient base not reflected in the UX
Stock banner image with logo baked into the photo
improvements: Editorial hero: 'The secret is medicine.' with Tirzepatide/Semaglutide chips and dual CTAs
Trust strip: dual board-certified, Google-verified reviews, bilingual care, financing
3-step GLP-1 program explainer (consult & labs, custom plan, guided check-ins)
Services grid for Body, Face, Health & Wellness plus Appetite Crush shop card
Dr. Ofelia Rodriguez founder section with credentials
Bilingual review marquee using real Google reviews
Cherry + CareCredit financing block, map, hours, consult form and sticky mobile call bar

emailSubject: A sharper site for Rejuveskin's body studio (built a preview)

problems: Domain is misspelled (rejuveskinspanutritrion.com) and the page title is just the URL

improvements: Centred-logo header: large crisp logo, split nav, top info bar, shrink-on-scroll and mobile menu
Editorial hero: 'Sculpt the body. Keep the curves.' with infrared/collagen/cryotherapy chips and Book/Call CTAs
Service marquee covering VacuShaper, Swan, Tulip, Roll Shaper, IV drips and aesthetics
4-step Rejuveskin method: training plan, supplements, meal plan, check-ins
Dark 'Body studio' section showing each machine with real studio photos
Wellness and Aesthetics service menu with photo thumbnails
Referral program card: free 30-min Roll Shaper for you, 15% off for your friend
Visit card with studio photo, address link, hours and call CTA beside a call-back form; sticky mobile Call/Book bar; studio gallery
Full dark footer: Book/Call CTA, brand blurb + socials, quick links, treatments, address, phone and hours
